# The Flash Seer

> A fortune cabinet for owners of the M-VAVE FM-1 synth: a seer asks seven strange questions, then deals a card that names the firmware you should flash. By Stephen Cummins (CÚ_STE).

- Two modes: "the machine" gives one synth tarot card; "the reading" deals three cards from a Celtic mythology deck.
- Sound is made in the browser and can be switched off.
- The firmware list comes from The Firmware Hub (thefirmwarehub.com, CC BY 4.0); each description is its maker's.

## Page

- [The Flash Seer](https://seer.stephen8n.com/): put a coin in

## Related

- [The Firmware Hub](https://thefirmwarehub.com/): where the firmware list comes from
